verdict.rationale: HubSpot's docs show natural-language operation in several places. Breeze Assistant lets you "describe the report you need in plain language" and HubSpot builds it, and a campaign can be planned "from a single goal." The official MCP server also gives any MCP-compatible AI agent read and write access to CRM data, so external natural-language agents can operate on contacts, deals and engagements. Missing for 10: evidence that the in-product assistant can run general CRM actions beyond reports and campaigns, detail on which operations the MCP tools cover, and independent or hands-on confirmation that natural-language commands work reliably.
